metaTitle: Custom 1 Inch Wide Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom 1 inch wide lanyards and badges in bulk. Ideal for ID cards, events, and security. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: For ID badges, trade show credentials, or daily security access, 1 inch wide lanyards offer a balanced width that shows off your logo without feeling bulky. This size works well with heavy-duty attachments like badge reels or card holders, making it a popular choice for schools, offices, and conferences. Options like the 1" Knit-In Lanyard provide a soft feel, while nylon web styles add durability for industrial use. Screen printing or woven text keeps your branding visible at a glance.
heroAltText: Custom 1 inch wide lanyards and badges with printed logos on a dark background.
